datasets.title: Indonesia - Potential Coastal Inundation
datasets.description: This is a shape file showing the potential for inundation on the coast of Palu City and its surroundings, as a result of the Central Sulawesi Tsunami. This file was generated by BMKG - the Indonesian Meteorological, Climatological, and Geophysical agency.. lineage.description: BMKG generated a tsunami inundation model for the Central Sulawesi event using hydrodynamic modeling to delineate potential coastal inundation zones in Palu City and surrounding areas. The output is a spatial polygon dataset representing the extent of potential tsunami-driven inundation.
